text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, nitrofurantoin 50 mg capsules are not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 353 capsules (25.7 days at 13.7/day). Corvale General holds 409 capsules (25.7 days at 15.9/day). Corvale Lakeside holds 29 capsules (11.4 days). Amneal Pharmaceuticals' nitrofurantoin oral suspension is posted by FDA as to be discontinued as of 2026-04-10, but this does not place the drug on the current shortage list.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows nitrofurantoin is not listed as of 2026-10-21. A separate FDA shortage posting notes Amneal Pharmaceuticals' nitrofurantoin oral suspension is to be discontinued as of 2026-04-10. The rule‑based alternate manufacturer ranked first is Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, which is not on FDA's shortage list today. Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited is identified on label a8a0d7d7 with FEI 3004956904; its last inspection was classified NAI on 2024-07-26. FDA inspection records for that FEI show multiple VAI classifications from 2010 through 2020, with the most recent VAI known date of 2020-06-11.

Our position: Current capsule inventory provides approximately 26 days at East and General, but only 11 days at Lakeside. No capsule presentation is on FDA's shortage list. Multiple alternate manufacturers are not on the shortage list. The Amneal suspension discontinuation does not affect capsule supply.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited (ranked first) for capsule supply; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition if not currently stocked.
2. Buyer to evaluate Almatica Pharma LLC, Alvogen Inc., Aurobindo Pharma Limited, and AvPAK as backup capsule sources; each requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition if not currently stocked.
3. Buyer to coordinate with Corvale Lakeside pharmacy to transfer stock from East or General to cover the 11‑day supply gap; requires pharmacy director approval.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly for any change to nitrofurantoin capsule status; no additional approval needed.

Not recommended: Switching to nitrofurantoin oral suspension given Amneal's discontinuation posting. Initiating therapeutic alternatives or dose changes; those are clinical decisions for treating clinicians and the committee.
